new_tooltip_samples.c-theme: Apply a ready-made color scheme. You can still tweak any setting afterward.
new_tooltip_samples.c-card-top: Top color of the card background gradient.
new_tooltip_samples.c-dyn-bg: Tint the card background from album art (needs Auto-color on).
new_tooltip_samples.c-border-colors: Colors the spinning border cycles through.
new_tooltip_samples.c-layout-lock-spectrum: Lock the spectrum so it cannot be dragged.

all_types_render_icon: colorPair (c-card-top) and colorList (c-border-colors) now show icons, alongside slider/toggle/select/text -- confirms the label-icon path covers every control type

no_clip.note: tooltip stays within the row (no right-edge clip). The onScreen check was not meaningful this session because the preview browser reported innerWidth 0 (headless viewport); within-row is the real guarantee + operator gate confirms live.
